'''Xon Trillus''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] living on the [[Eternal Empire]] capital of [[Zakuul]]. He was a member of the [[Heralds of Zildrog]], a cult worshipping the mythical serpent-god [[Zildrog]] that controlled the [[Old World]] of Zakuul. In [[3631 BBY]] he was among the Heralds present at the [[Razor (Zakuul)|Razor]], when it was attacked by [[Alliance Commander|the Commander]] wanted for the assassination of Emperor [[Valkorion]]. Xon engaged the Outlander and their companion, but was killed during the fight.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Xon Trillus appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' '''Chapter 7: The Lady of Sorrows'''.
